subject: Quality and creative ownership clarification for same latest Falcon exploration
body:
Ziggy's quality/ownership clarification to SAME latest Falcon scope 1434a639-025e-4af1-9840-49e2cd91a5b0, not a new generation launch: BEST-QUALITY finished-looking cinematic realism, not rough/low-effort. 'Draft' means exploratory creative status and freedom to invent relevant categories/prompts without per-idea approval this round; it does not lower visual quality or imply canon/production/shot/timing acceptance. No first-sample approval gate requested now.

Keep 1,000 OVERALL, 15-30 variants/category at your judgment, EVERY returned image in full accessible archive plus hand-curated strongest review set, existing paid allowance only/no purchases. Reconcile existing jobs without duplicating them.

Character/model-reference image work AND storyboard images belong in your CREATIVE bucket. CFA retains overall coordination, benchmark/technical dispatch and intake. Other-project branch uses EXISTING HaL Grok bot/thread that made its established main-character images. Do not create a new operator or mix HaL context with Falcon. Exact HaL/project routing is being resolved before scoped direction; no second mandatory1,000 quota implied or new HaL launch here.
